scope: Assigned CodeQL findings only; no assertion that shared writable workspaces are a filesystem isolation boundary.

findings.reachability: CLI generate/compose reads workspace .clank/generated-baseline.json. A concurrent local writer could swap the checked pathname or grow it after its size check. No HTTP route or proposal-only input grants that filesystem authority.
findings.change: Read a single O_NOFOLLOW/nonblocking opened handle; fstat regular-file check; at most16MiB+1 bytes; reject final/parent identity, size, mtime or ctime changes before returning parsed data.
tests: tests/blueprint-baseline.test.mjs: regular file and final/parent symlinks

findings.reachability: CLI compose reads a target file after lstat. Exploitation requires concurrent direct write authority to the same target; proposal JSON alone cannot swap files. Exact lstat/readFile sequence predates this branch.
findings.neededFix: No introduced remote/security-boundary regression. Optional future descriptor-based snapshot reads and filesystem transaction redesign; not changed under narrow review scope.

findings.reachability: Local transactionalWrite backups use preexisting lstat/readFile sequence. New generator reuses this helper; trusted current-user process can race a writable workspace, but untrusted blueprint input cannot. Added expectedSha256 detects stale snapshots and is not a shared-host filesystem isolation claim.
findings.neededFix: Optional descriptor-based backup snapshots plus broader parent-directory write/rollback race design; a read-only patch would not establish isolation for same-user concurrent writers.

findings.reachability: New stdio editor synchronously compiles accepted documents up to1MiB. Valid TS comment containing an unterminated import-like quote and repeated !.ts# forces repeated suffix backtracking. No network listener is required to stall the language-server process on a repository document.
findings.change: Match each complete quoted literal once with disjoint escaped-character branches; find query/hash and .ts/.tsx suffix in linear callback operations.
tests: tests/compiler-runtime.test.mjs: imports, reexports, dynamic imports, query/hash preservation
tests/compiler-runtime.test.mjs: near1MiB hostile document compiled in subprocess with5s hard timeout
